verdict.rationale: Delaware documents a mail and fax fallback for its own processes. Name reservations can be uploaded, faxed or mailed, and entity formation forms are fillable PDFs that can be submitted by mail. The evidence does not show the exact mailing address or fax number, and annual reports and franchise taxes are explicitly required to be filed online, so the most important recurring task has no published fallback. Missing for 10: exact published mailing address and fax number, a paper or offline fallback for annual report and franchise tax filing, and independent corroboration that the mail and fax rails work.
